instructors.name: Anjali Kumari
instructors.bio: Software engineer turned educator. ex-Walmart Global Tech, ex-Morgan Stanley, ex-Nagarro. ECE graduate from PSIT Kanpur who broke into product companies from a non-CS, non-metro background — and built RisingBrain so the next generation wouldn't have to figure it out alone.

courses.title: DSA Mastery: Patterns to Product Companies
courses.blurb: The flagship roadmap — 28 reusable patterns across 1,200+ problems, sequenced exactly the way top product companies test.

courses.title: 30-Day DSA Challenge
courses.blurb: Anjali's signature challenge — one focused topic a day to build unstoppable consistency before placement season.

courses.title: SQL for Interviews
courses.blurb: From joins to window functions — problem, best approach and clean query side by side, tuned for data rounds.

courses.title: System Design Fundamentals
courses.blurb: Scalability, caching, sharding and real architectures — everything you need for the HLD interview round.

courses.title: Low-Level Design (LLD) in Java
courses.blurb: Master OOP, SOLID and design patterns through hands-on machine-coding rounds asked at product companies.

courses.title: Dynamic Programming Deep Dive
courses.blurb: Demystify DP with a state-first framework — from memoization basics to the hardest interview favourites.

courses.title: Aptitude & Logical Reasoning
courses.blurb: Crisp topic theory plus timed MCQ drills to clear the very first placement filter with speed and accuracy.

courses.title: Interview Crash Course: HR & Behavioral
courses.blurb: Nail the behavioral round — STAR stories, resume deep-dives and salary negotiation, in one weekend.
